error.message:
open the watch: permission denied (Permission denied (os error 13)). Let your user open Garmin devices, then reconnect the watch:
  echo 'SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="091e", MODE="0660", TAG+="uaccess"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/70-georgian-for-garmin.rules && sudo udevadm control --reload
That is the rule shipped as 70-georgian-for-garmin.rules.
